excerpt: Baksan Neutrino Observatory, 43°16'32"N 42°41'25"E, 2,100 m (6,900 ft) underground; 50-57 tonnes liquid gallium metal; construction/start December 1989; primary data-taking January 1990-December 2007 (168 extractions); end August 2011 with continued operations thereafter; 65.4 SNU capture rate vs. 138 SNU predicted; led by Vladimir Gavrin, Georgiy Zatsepin, Thomas J. Bowles; JINR (Russia) and LANL (USA).
title: Soviet–American Gallium Experiment
